market_summary: During the London session, markets exhibit low breakout participation across all five symbols. Metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD) and US100 are pressing against session support and Value Area Lows without confirmed expansion volume, while GBPUSD stalls at its Session High and upper ATR band with pronounced bearish CVD divergence. BTCUSD remains compressed around Point of Control inside its Value Area. With conditions dominated by mean-reversion chop and absence of RVOL > 2.0 breakout triggers, all assets are maintained on HOLD.

signals.rationale: In the LONDON_SESSION, price is inside the Value Area (VAH 3911.53, VAL 3884.20) and trading below the POC at 3896.98. The CVD is -2.08 with a BEARISH label (slope -0.02), agreeing with downward drift. Price is trading below session VWAP at 3902.82 and below the EMA50 baseline at 3901.22, positioned in the lower half of the ATR channel approaching the lower ATR band at 3884.96. RVOL is 0.965 with no yellow volume breakout spikes (last spike 70 bars ago). Price is currently testing S/R support at 3887.45 above the Session Low at 3878.91; selling into support inside the Value Area without volume confirmation carries poor expectancy, warranting a HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below declining VWAP and EMA50
